title: Senior Software Engineer - VOIP / SIP
description:
About the Company
 



 Practice by Numbers (PbN) is building medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market—software that helps dental teams run smoother, grow revenue, and improve patient experience. The platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation into a single system, replacing scattered tools and manual workflows trusted by thousands of practices across North America.
 



 PbN is mission\-driven and execution\-oriented: high ownership, tight cross\-functional collaboration, and product work with clear, measurable impact. You'll get real autonomy and see direct results in a large, under\-digitized healthcare vertical that's actively moving toward AI\-first workflows.
 



  





 Position Overview
 



 This role owns the design and implementation of PbN's core VoIP/SIP telephony backbone—the infrastructure layer that powers calling, routing, and communication workflows for thousands of dental practices. You will architect and build carrier\-grade SIP services in Golang on top of open\-source components, and integrate the telephony stack with PbN's broader AI\-first SaaS platform. The role reports to the Engineering India Head and sits at the intersection of deep infrastructure work and product\-facing impact.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Design and implement a carrier\-grade SIP/VoIP core using Kamailio or OpenSIPS for SIP signaling and FreeSWITCH or similar for media and application services.
* Build Golang\-based SIP services—registrar, SBC\-like components, routing logic, monitoring daemons—and internal APIs to control routing, policies, and provisioning.
* Configure and operate SIP load balancing, failover, and high\-availability setups across multi\-node SIP proxies, distributed media servers, and RTP proxies.
* Implement and maintain dial plans, least\-cost routing, DID management, class\-4/class\-5 switching logic, and integrations with upstream carriers and PSTN gateways.
* Own security and robustness of the VoIP stack: TLS/SRTP, authentication, rate limiting, fraud detection hooks, and abuse controls.
* Integrate the telephony backbone with PbN's SaaS platform via well\-defined internal APIs and webhooks, covering user accounts, billing, analytics, and AI/automation flows.
* Define and own monitoring, alerting, logging, and capacity planning for SIP signaling, RTP/media, and VoIP quality metrics (MOS, jitter, packet loss).



  





 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 7–10 years of software development experience with at least 4–5 years building or operating large\-scale VoIP/SIP systems in production.
* Strong Golang skills including high\-performance networked services, concurrent processing, and production\-grade APIs.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one open\-source SIP server—Kamailio, OpenSIPS, or Asterisk—including configuration, routing logic, and packet\-level troubleshooting.
* Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, SDP, NAT traversal, registrar/registration flows, B2BUA vs. proxy behavior, and SBC concepts.
* Proven ability to design and operate highly available telephony backbones: clustering, health checks, load balancing, and graceful failover.
* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals—iptables, firewalls, TCP/UDP, QoS—with comfort debugging at packet level using tcpdump or Wireshark.
* Experience integrating VoIP platforms with RESTful backends and databases (PostgreSQL or MariaDB/MySQL) and message queues for control and billing workflows.



  





 Nice to Have
 


* Experience with WebRTC, SIP over WebSockets, and browser or mobile softphone integrations.
* Familiarity with VoIP billing, rating engines, CDR processing, and reseller hierarchies (class\-4/class\-5 softswitch products or similar).
* Cloud\-native deployment of VoIP stacks—containerized Kamailio or FreeSWITCH clusters on AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, service meshes.
* Prior work building call center or CPaaS\-style platforms including programmable IVRs, call queues, and analytics.



  





 What We Offer
 


* End\-to\-end ownership of a mission\-critical infrastructure layer powering thousands of live dental practices across North America.
* Direct exposure to AI\-first product evolution—conversational automation, intelligent call routing, and front\-office workflow integration.
* High\-autonomy environment with tight cross\-functional collaboration across product, engineering, and operations.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with senior infrastructure expertise.
* Flexible scheduling within a fast\-moving, execution\-oriented team with real measurable impact.

title: Software Engineer (Secrets Manager)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at www.bitwarden.com.
   

  

 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced Engineers \& Senior Engineers. As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Secrets Manager team, you will lead the development of our dedicated secrets engine, machine\-to\-machine (M2M) authorization protocols, and developer\-focused CLI/SDKs. Looking ahead, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the core infrastructure that extends Secrets Manager into our next\-generation
 **AI Identity and Access** 
 management platform—securing ciphers, credentials, and API keys against the unique custody risks of autonomous AI agents and headless workloads.
   

  

 In alignment with our modern
 **True Ownership** 
 model, our engineers are "T\-shaped" professionals who own their services end\-to\-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production \[cite: Transforming Engineering Through Ownership]. You will collaborate closely in a synchronous "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to design and ship elegant, secure, and resilient code.
   

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
* Platform \& Feature Development: Design, build, and maintain high\-performance APIs, SDKs, and CLIs for Secrets Manager and our future AI Identity and Access security frameworks.
* Machine \& AI Identity Custody: Implement secure, zero\-knowledge machine authentication, scoped access tokens, and runtime secrets injection gateways that protect credentials from being exposed to parent AI models or local execution environments.
* Decoupled Architecture: Work within our Decoupled Platform Architecture to ensure Secrets Manager operates as a highly scalable, independent tenant using its own dedicated data stores and asynchronous event\-driven message networks.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Own the automated testing, deployment pipelines, and production SRE health of your team's services, participating in on\-call rotations and postmortem analyses to drive continuous operational improvement.
* Developer Usability: Build usable, highly developer\-friendly API endpoints, integration libraries, and comprehensive technical documentation to lower the friction of secrets enrollment and machine onboarding.
* Security \& Compliance: Proactively threat\-model new services, remediate security vulnerabilities, and ensure our secrets engine maintains our strict, audited compliance standards .


**WHAT YOU BRING**
* Overall Experience: 3\-6 years in Software Engineering
* Technical Stack: Strong proficiency and experience in AI\-Led Development in Rust, C\# / .NET, or TypeScript (our core Secrets Manager SDK is built in Rust).
* Identity \& Secrets Management: Practical experience designing or integrating machine identity platforms, vaulting services, OAuth/OIDC, or token\-based authorization structures (e.g., JWT, access tokens, API keys).
* AI/Agent Security Interest: Curiosity or experience with the security implications of AI agent architectures, large language model (LLM) memory isolation, or sandboxed execution environments.
* T\-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Experience writing robust automated integration tests, maintaining containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), and using modern APM and SRE logging tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Grafana) to monitor services in production.
* Cryptographic Foundations: Solid grasp of symmetric/asymmetric encryption, zero\-knowledge protocols, and OS\-level secure storage APIs.
* Collaborative Mindset: Excitement to work in a high\-velocity, outcome\-driven environment using rapid prototyping and data\-driven prioritization.
* Open Source \& Communication: Excellent written communication and a strong passion for open\-source software, developer tooling, and modern internet security.


**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**
* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
